prompt: [Character] Image 1 [Signature] In the lower right corner, there is a small Threads logo operated by Meta, with "CHAse" written above it in white cursive like a signature. [Subject's Pose and Expression] Pose and Composition: A front-centered, medium full-length shot (Full-length Shot) capturing the full silhouette of a person sitting cross-legged on the threshold of an open classic white door frame. Posture: Naturally sitting cross-legged, holding a glass of water near the mouth in a pensive pose. The geometric symmetry of the frame makes the subject stand out. Expression: A calm gaze looking toward the right side of the screen rather than directly at the camera. A modern and chic city natural vibe is created from a neat, unexaggerated mask. [Character Outfit and Props] Outfit: Top: A pure white short-sleeved buttoned knit cardigan with a fine vertical ribbed pattern, layered with a simple nude beige-toned crop top matched inside. The loose sleeves of the cardigan naturally expose the shoulder lines. Bottoms: Wearing vintage short pants with a cheerful pink and green vertical stripe pattern. A small white label (Logo) positioned in the center of the waistband adds a stylish point. Props: Transparent water glass: The transparent glass held in the right hand emphasizes visual clarity and freshness. White sneakers & socks: Simple pure white cotton crew socks (Socks) rising above the ankles paired with classic white high-top sneakers with natural scratches, maximizing a natural and private homewear vibe. [Character Hairstyle and Makeup Details] Hair: A calm jet black / dark brown straight long hairstyle with a 5:5 part that falls neatly over the shoulders and back. The neat hair line adds to the minimal aesthetic. Makeup: A clean and transparent cool-toned skin base with perfectly organized imperfections, matched with brown shadow eye makeup that lightly emphasizes the eyes. The lips are neatly finished with a calm nude coral pink that enhances the natural flush. [Lighting and Light Direction] Light Source: Soft diffused natural light from the front-left window and studio cool-tone ambient lighting (Soft Diffused Daylight). Effect: Creates calm highlights on the skin texture, the ribbed knit texture, and the subtle painted surface of the white wooden door behind, creating a modern and neat contrast. [Texture and Color Mood (Core Texture Details)] Color: A 'Modern City Natural' color mood consisting of clean snow white for the outfit and socks, warm beige for the crop top, pink and green for the striped pants, and a calm grayish-white background. Texture Details (Special Analysis): Weaving and knit texture: The dense vertical ribbed (Ribbed) texture of the cardigan and the soft, fluffy cotton weave texture of the socks. Wood texture: The smooth yet subtle wood grain visible under the painted surface of the classic door frame behind the subject. Fabric texture: The light yet dense cotton fabric texture of the striped pants. [Film and Camera Lens Depth, Angle] Composition and Angle: A horizontal front-facing composition at eye-level with the subject sitting on the terrace floor, providing a stable and neat portrait angle. Features: Captured clearly using a standard portrait field of view with sharp focus (Sharp Focus), highlighting the model's features, the knit ribbing, the weave of the socks, and the wood texture of the door frame, while the background wall is neatly organized to maximize immersion in the subject. [Background and Studio Layout Elements] Space: The interior of a white studio terrace with a clean, minimalist, and classic interior. Details: The clean white door frame behind the subject, the warm wooden flooring inside, and the minimalist white walls support the neatness of the space.

promptZh: [角色] 图像 1 [签名] 右下角有一个由 Meta 运营的 Threads 小图标，上方用白色草书写着“CHAse”作为签名。[主体姿势与表情] 姿势与构图：正面居中的中景全身照（Full-length Shot），捕捉人物盘腿坐在经典白色门框门槛上的完整轮廓。姿势：自然盘腿而坐，手持一杯水靠近嘴边，呈现沉思姿态。门框的几何对称性使主体更加突出。表情：平静的目光看向画面右侧，而非直视镜头。整洁、不夸张的妆容营造出一种现代且时髦的都市自然氛围。[角色服装与道具] 服装：上衣：纯白色短袖纽扣针织开衫，带有细密的垂直罗纹图案，内搭简约的裸米色短款上衣。开衫宽松的袖口自然地露出了肩部线条。下装：穿着复古短裤，带有明快的粉色和绿色垂直条纹图案。腰带中央的小白标（Logo）增添了时尚感。道具：透明水杯：右手持有的透明玻璃杯强调了视觉上的通透感与清新感。白色运动鞋与袜子：脚踝上方穿着简约的纯白色棉质中筒袜（Socks），搭配带有自然磨损痕迹的经典白色高帮运动鞋，最大程度地展现了自然且私密的居家氛围。[角色发型与妆容细节] 发型：沉稳的纯黑/深棕色直长发，五五分发缝，整齐地垂落在肩部和背部。利落的发际线增添了极简美感。妆容：干净透明的冷色调底妆，完美修饰了瑕疵，搭配轻微强调眼部的棕色系眼影。唇部采用沉稳的裸珊瑚粉色，提升了自然气色。[光线与光照方向] 光源：来自左前方窗户的柔和漫射自然光和摄影棚冷色调环境光（Soft Diffused Daylight）。效果：在皮肤纹理、罗纹针织质感以及身后白色木门微妙的漆面上营造出柔和的高光，形成了现代且整洁的对比。[质感与色彩基调（核心质感细节）] 色彩：一种“现代都市自然”色彩基调，由服装和袜子的纯雪白色、短款上衣的暖米色、条纹裤的粉绿色以及沉稳的灰白色背景组成。质感细节（特别分析）：编织与针织质感：开衫致密的垂直罗纹（Ribbed）质感，以及袜子柔软蓬松的棉质编织纹理。木质纹理：主体身后经典门框漆面下隐约可见的细腻木纹。织物纹理：条纹裤轻盈而致密的棉质面料质感。[胶片与相机镜头景深、角度] 构图与角度：水平正面构图，与坐在露台地板上的主体保持视线平齐，提供了稳定且整洁的肖像视角。特征：使用标准肖像视野清晰捕捉，焦点锐利（Sharp Focus），突出了模特的五官、针织罗纹、袜子编织纹理以及门框的木质纹理，同时背景墙面处理得非常整洁，最大程度地增强了对主体的沉浸感。[背景与摄影棚布局元素] 空间：白色摄影棚露台内部，拥有干净、极简且经典的室内设计。细节：主体身后干净的白色门框、室内温暖的木质地板以及极简的白色墙壁，共同支撑起空间的整洁感。
